promise: SpaceX will conduct an uncrewed lunar landing by March 2027
description: The Wall Street Journal reported that SpaceX told investors it will prioritise the Moon before Mars and target an uncrewed lunar landing in March 2027. Musk publicly confirmed the Moon-first strategy, saying SpaceX aims to build a 'self-growing city' on the Moon within 10 years while still intending a city on Mars.
evidence: WSJ report on SpaceX investor communication, February 6, 2026
Musk posts on X confirming the Moon-first strategy, February 8, 2026
